sources.title: Enfold — Predictive Representations for Efficient Embodied Control
sources.snippet: Research project · efficient embodied control Enfold Folding World-Generator Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control A world generator does not need to render a future at every control step. Enfold transfers the computation that constructs a future into a representation inferred from the present.
